notes: Paper presents projected exclusion limits (not measured) for ultralight B−L dark photon dark matter using optomechanical cavity sensors. Main result in Fig. 5 shows 90% CL limits on gauge coupling g_BL vs mass m_a. The paper develops a novel three-peak Fourier-space analysis accounting for Earth's rotation (peaks at m, m±ω⊕) and stochastic vector field properties. Updated MICROSCOPE limit in Appendix E gives g_BL ≲ 8.93×10^-19 (dimensionless), but the optomechanical cavity projections in Fig. 5 reach ~7×10^-26 at low masses (5×10^-20 to 5×10^-15 eV range). The coupling_convention is dimensionless g_BL as used in the paper. DM density assumed is ρ ~ 0.3 GeV/cm³ (standard galactic halo value, implicit in a₀ definition). Data points extracted from Fig. 5 showing the three resonance frequency curves; values are approximate from plot reading.
